independent_materiality.governance_proposition: Actual caught runs support bounded positive monitoring performance, while context failures and filtered comparisons remain distinct.

condition_tests.literal_condition: An applicable validly activated protective control faces its governed hazard.
condition_tests.assessment: A monitor is active against seeded side-task hazards.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The control produces a timely effect sufficient for its protective purpose and evidenced context, including any justified heightened protection.
condition_tests.assessment: For correctly caught runs, its bounded detection purpose is achieved; this is not a promise to catch every run.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Observed intervention and hazard outcome demonstrate the required containment or mitigation rather than activation alone.
condition_tests.assessment: Measured caught outcomes support positive recognition for that subset, subject to run-level confirmation.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): The applicable control does not become operative when a valid activation condition occurs; assess Required Control Activation.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The control becomes operative even though its valid activation or applicability conditions are not satisfied; assess Control Activation Validity.

Not aligned exclusion: The control becomes operative with a sufficient effect but its operative state is later lost, weakened, reset, or transformed before reaching the governed point; assess Control-State Preservation.

Class scope exclusion (all results): An operative governance signal fails to reach any capable endpoint or execution surface; assess the applicable governance-control reach class rather than treating non-delivery as inadequate control effect.
Not aligned exclusion: The control produces the protective effect required by its defined purpose and the remaining harm arises through an independent downstream mechanism.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The dispute is solely that policy should have required a stronger safeguard, without evidence of an applicable operational control or protective-effect obligation in the material context.

Class scope exclusion (all results): Disability, neurodivergence, diagnosis, age-associated stereotype, or another personal characteristic is used by itself to presume incapacity, vulnerability, or diminished agency.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Failure on other cases does not erase correct bounded detections. Context-overflow nonprocessing must not be silently counted as a valid evaluated response.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: E002’s missed detections remain a separate failure.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A monitoring control is required for the relevant class of conduct.
condition_tests.assessment: Required monitoring applies to the benchmark transcript.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Material conduct occurs through a path or condition outside effective monitor coverage.
condition_tests.assessment: Context-limit cases can prevent effective inspection, unlike ordinary below-threshold scores on consumed text.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The coverage gap prevents or materially degrades intended detection, review, or intervention.
condition_tests.assessment: The source describes such processing failures, but the exact duty across the complete trace needs run-level scope.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The monitor observes the conduct but a downstream reviewer fails to act.
Class scope exclusion (all results): Monitoring is not required for the relevant conduct or assurance level.
Not aligned exclusion: The issue is only poor alert quality while material activity remains captured.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Captured material with a weak decision is not necessarily coverage failure; nonconsumed required trace may be.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: A filtered subset cannot certify coverage of omitted long runs.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Reconsider bounded FC083 positives for correctly caught runs and separately inspect context-limit failures for FC023/083 localisation. Comparison caveats are material; they should not exclude actual control successes from consideration.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: No independently distinct missing invariant established.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Run IDs, full coverage requirements and exact consumed traces needed before final per-occurrence admission.
rows.other_incident_implications: Treat correct detections, consumed-but-missed cases and nonprocessed traces separately in monitor audits.

condition_tests.assessment: Measured evaluation results are published and revised.

condition_tests.assessment: Dated changes disclose material numerical and contextual alterations.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The evidence is preserved accurately but supports an unfavourable conclusion.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The missing information was never captured in the first place.
Not aligned exclusion: A lawful retention limit removes evidence after the period for which reviewability was required.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Initial measurement error is distinct from later evidence tampering. Transparent correction does not independently validate the corrected experiment.
